# Pages the working session's egress proxy blocks. One URL per line; blanks and #comments
# ignored. Editing this file runs the "Fetch a doc" workflow, which prints each page as text
# into its job log.
#
# Public, read-only pages only.

# Refetched for its links, not its prose: the page says to "submit the request form" for the
# write_mobile_payments and read_mobile_payments scopes, and the Dev Dashboard now rejects both
# as invalid — which is that approval, pending. The form's URL is the thing that is needed and
# the text renderers dropped it.
https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts/mobile/create-apple-payment-processing-certificates

# Answered: admin-created custom apps are retired; the client credentials grant replaces them.
# https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/authentication-authorization/access-tokens

# Apple's docs are JavaScript-only, so a plain fetch returns "This page requires JavaScript"
# and nothing else — but every page offers a Markdown twin for automated tools at the same URL
# with .md appended. That is the readable form; always ask for it on developer.apple.com.
#
# Still open: can the App Store Connect API create a Merchant ID and enable the Apple Pay
# capability on an App ID? /merchant-ids 404s, so either it is named something else or the API
# does not cover merchant identifiers at all. The endpoint list settles it.
https://developer.apple.com/documentation/appstoreconnectapi.md
https://developer.apple.com/documentation/appstoreconnectapi/bundle-id-capabilities.md

# The planet basemap build sizes — the one number docs/basemap.md estimates rather than states.
# build.protomaps.com/ returned 404 for the bare root; the listing lives one level in.
https://build.protomaps.com/builds

# The travel journal range. Etch has one bound product (the Year Book, a layflat A4 landscape
# photo book at $119) and this is a different object at a different price point — a notebook you
# take with you rather than a book you are given afterwards. Reading the page for what the range
# sheet never states: the exact SKUs, page counts, paper, binding, and whether the cover print
# area is one wrap or a front panel. Guessing a SKU off a prefix has failed four times out of
# four in this project; reading the product page has worked every time.
https://www.prodigi.com/products/cards-and-stationery/themed-notebooks-and-journals/travel-journals/
